BiblicalUsage: Mearah is a place on the coast beside the Sidonians, named in the land still to be taken. Joshua lists it among the towns the tribes had yet to possess when he divided Canaan.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the places named and not yet taken are part of the promise: God counts the land His people have not reached yet, and the map of what remains is still His.
